claims.text: Flash synthesis yields uniform, homogeneous Fe–Ni–Cr–Co–Cu solid-solution nanoparticles.
The as-synthesized Fe–Ni–Cr–Co–Cu nanoparticles have a random atomic distribution.
The as-synthesized Fe–Ni–Cr–Co–Cu nanoparticles contain minimal inherent short-range chemical order.
Prolonged intermediate-temperature annealing will increase short-range chemical order in the nanoparticles.
Rapid quenching will preserve complete chemical randomness in the control nanoparticles.
Five-element HEA nanoparticles can exhibit element-pair-specific short-range chemical order even when long-range chemical ordering is absent.
Short-range chemical ordering creates regions with more uniform bonding environments.
Short-range chemical ordering increases local cohesive energy.
The increase in local cohesive energy raises the thermal activation barrier for atomic mobility.
A higher barrier to atomic mobility delays the onset of premelting.
A higher barrier to atomic mobility increases the effective melting temperature.
Annealed, short-range-ordered nanoparticles will begin premelting at a higher temperature than rapidly quenched nanoparticles.
Annealed, short-range-ordered nanoparticles will have a higher effective melting temperature than rapidly quenched nanoparticles.
The random solid solution premelts earlier because it contains heterogeneous bonding strengths.
The proposed mechanism applies primarily in the nanoparticle size regime during premelting and melting.
Surface segregation or extreme heating and cooling rates may dominate the thermal response and limit the proposed mechanism.
Annealing may introduce grain growth or unwanted phase transformations that confound the effect of short-range order.
Nanoparticle size and surface-condition variations may alter measured melting behavior.

contradictions.description: The initial and baseline states are alternately described as having minimal short-range order and as possessing complete or full chemical randomness. Complete randomness excludes nonzero short-range chemical correlations, whereas 'minimal' order can allow them.
